purpose: Public-safe contract for locating, updating, validating, and exporting the user's private/current social-media post index without committing the managed corpus to this repository.

known_artifacts.sqlite: runtime-discovered; full long-form bodies and FTS are expected when the SQLite artifact is available

source_selection: Locate the current index artifacts from the user's connected file/library sources before editing.
Prefer the richest current writable source; do not assume CSV is authoritative merely because it is easy to parse.
When SQLite is available, preserve full long-form bodies there and rebuild/verify posts_fts.
Keep CSV and XLSX as synchronized exports/views of the same indexed corpus, not competing authorities.
If artifact freshness conflicts or the SQLite source cannot be located, stop promotion of uncertain state and record hmmm.

id_rule.allocation: monotonic next unused numeric ID after deduplication
never: assign a new ID to a cross-platform variant without linking its source in notes/source metadata

scope.include: user-authored public social content and publication artifacts
exclude: unattributable screenshots presented as user-authored content
scope.unresolved: Keep inspected-but-unattributable candidates outside the user corpus with explicit unresolved state.

character_count.rule: Preserve the exact/source-declared count when provenance supplies one; otherwise calculate from the stored body and record any platform-specific effective count separately in notes or runtime validation rather than silently changing historical semantics.
character_count.publishing_gate: Before calling a draft publishable, apply the current platform/form/tier rule from platform_rules.json. Near a hard limit, validate with the live composer because platform counting can differ from simple string length.

append_workflow: retrieve current index and platform rules
recover exact candidate text and provenance
deduplicate by post_id, source locator, exact body, and materially equivalent recovered artifact
classify publication/recovery status without promotion by inference
allocate stable post_id only after deduplication
apply topic taxonomy and source metadata
calculate character metadata and platform fit
rebuild/verify posts_fts when SQLite is available
read back the new row by post_id and search terms
validation: confirmed_posted requires visible or platform-source evidence
exact text requires exact source text
publication_ready is never promoted to confirmed_posted from absence of contrary evidence
the appended row is retrievable by post_id
the appended row is discoverable through FTS when SQLite/FTS is available
exports preserve the same post_id, status, provenance, and body recovery state
unresolved source or publication state remains hmmm
hmmm: The exact current Library identity/path of the SQLite database is runtime state and must be discovered rather than committed here.
A future schema migration may add explicit platform_count/platform_limit fields; do not mutate the existing corpus schema merely to anticipate that change.
